articles.title: The Shape-Shifting DNA Behind the Octopus Brain
articles.summary: Cephalopod DNA was rearranged again and again over hundreds of millions of years, building the complex nervous systems behind their camouflage and smarts.

articles.title: Jupiter Has Its Own, Busier Way of Blocking the Solar Wind
articles.summary: NASA's Juno spacecraft found Jupiter uses richer plasma waves and extra mini-shocks to slow the solar wind, unlike Earth's simpler shield.

articles.title: Two Electrons Team Up to Break a Physics Limit
articles.summary: Firing ultraviolet lasers at helium, researchers made X-rays more energetic than the standard limit allows, by releasing two electrons' energy at once.
